idea-plugin.name: Forge BPMN
idea-plugin.description:
View and edit BPMN 2.0 diagrams in IntelliJ IDEA. Camunda Modeler-style canvas, properties panel, XML round-trip, and basic syntax lint.

Opens .bpmn in a Camunda Modeler-style editor (bpmn-js Cloud distribution, properties panel, XML round-trip) with basic BPMN syntax lint.

The editor tabs switch between XML and the BPMN diagram. Diagram edits write back to the XML document.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Built with Java 25 against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.
  • Native BPMN / XML editor tabs, with round-trip sync.
  • Camunda Modeler-style diagram editor, properties panel, and BPMN syntax lint.
